title: Measuring Bias in Contextualized Word Representations

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the log probability bias score by querying a masked language model (BERT) with template sentences to evaluate associations between male/female targets and attributes like career/family, math/arts, science/arts, job salaries, and skills. It is also evaluated downstream using the Gendered Pronoun Resolution (GPR) task.

Using the proposed log probability bias score to measure associations between European American vs. African American names and pleasant/unpleasant attributes using WEAT (Word Embedding Association Test) stimuli adapted into template sentences.
